blockingIssues.description: IdempotencyPort (outbound, high-level port) has no adapter implementation registered as @Bean. Spring context fails during test initialization with NoSuchBeanDefinitionException. RecordAuditFactService requires IdempotencyPort but it is not provided.
blockingIssues.rootCause: Interface com.neuroassist.hist.application.port.out.IdempotencyPort exists but no @Component implementing it. Only IdempotencyEntryRepositoryPort (lower-level port) has adapter IdempotencyEntryRepositoryAdapter.
blockingIssues.solution: Create IdempotencyAdapter (or similar) that implements IdempotencyPort and wraps IdempotencyEntryRepositoryPort. Register as @Component.

blockingIssues.description: ChainVerificationServiceTest has unnecessary stubbing: UnnecessaryStubbingException. Mock configurations are set up but not all are used in test flow.
blockingIssues.rootCause: Mockito strict mode detects when(hashChainPort.genesis()).thenReturn(GENESIS) is never called in some test paths.
blockingIssues.solution: Remove unused stubs or use lenient() mode for this test class.
